DREAD  DR0, CR0, #0, DR0
RETURN

DREAD  DR0, CR0, #0, DR1
RETURN
LOAD  CR0, CR6[0x0000]
DREAD  DR0, CR0, #0, DR2
RETURN
LOAD  CR0, CR6[0x0000]
DREAD  DR0, CR0, #0, DR3
RETURN
LOAD  CR0, CR6[0x0000]
DREAD  DR0, CR0, #0, DR4
RETURN
LOAD  CR1, CR6[0x0001]
L0:
DWRITE  DR0, CR1, #0, DR0
RETURN
description: Boot3 — the boot trampoline lump (token 00000600, NS slot 6) executed by the hardware ROM during boot phases B:01–B:07.  Loads NS, Thread, and Boot3 lumps, then CALL CR0 (Thread.CR[0]) enters the configured first abstraction directly.
